critique: The terracotta staple field and interlocking cream, olive, cobalt, and ochre “slabs” form a forceful mid-key ledger whose rigid counting logic is productively disrupted by bars crossing the photographic panel. The staple photograph remains a familiar repetition study rather than an unfamiliar texture language, while the 17-pixel guinea pig is effectively illegible; abstract the staples more radically and give that anomalous animal enough scale to register as a deliberate rupture.
